safe.model

Class SafeTestJNA

  • java.lang.Object
    • safe.model.SafeTestJNA
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class SafeTestJNA
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
    SafeTestJNA is the class for calling native functions in STICS FORTRAN via JNA Available native functions are : ================================= verifParam : general parameters initialization verification verifPlant : plants and itk parameters initialization verification initClimat : climatic data initialization annualLoopStart : annual loop initialization addLitterInSoil : add carbon litters from tree (branches, stem, leaves, roots) dailyLoopPart1 : daily loop part 1 dailyLoopPart2 : daily loop part 2 annualLoopEnd : annual loop end process
    See Also:
